headline: Uzbekistan will move to a new model of economic growth. What task did Shavkat Mirziyoyev give?
summary: Uzbekistan will move from 2027 to economic growth based on technology, exports and higher value-added products. Plans include raising services exports to $29 billion and developing strategies for 10 sectors.
why: Economic growth models set the policy direction for a country's export sectors, investment flows and reform priorities. Investors track these shifts when assessing long-term prospects in emerging markets.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston iqtisodiy o‘sishning yangi modeliga o‘tadi. Shavkat Mirziyoyev qanday topshiriq berdi?
